title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis — Episode4 Surprising Support

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Event Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Line: A few days later
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I had the others listen to the way I sing in order to figure out what my habits are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...is about all I got.
Did I sound weird or off in any way...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I didn't really hear anything weird.
I thought you were really good, Nene. Your singing was as pretty as ever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm also struggling to find any such faults.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
We practiced singing a few times during that workshop I attended...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm not sure any of the comments or criticisms I or the others there were given that time apply to you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Could you tell me what they told you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: One person was told, “To sing with a clearer voice from the opening” while another was, “Articulate better so that it's easier to discern the lyrics.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, neither of those really apply to Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As far as what the layperson would know, vibratos and glissandos also come to mind... But I can't think of much else...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're both an experienced stage performer and a talented singer, Nene. So, your “habits” may have nothing to do with your singing skills...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This has nothing to do with my singing skills...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone...
I know you're all busy working on your own roles, so I really appreciate your help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't wanna take up more of your time, so I'll try giving this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still don't know what my habits are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess this director was right. This isn't gonna be easy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? It's getting light out...
I completely lost track of time while practicing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What time is it? Where's my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! Thirty unread messages?!
From the Wonderlands×Showtime group too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Uh oh...
Did something happen without me realizing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
There's a video here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Hiii, Neneee!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<How's singing practice going?!
I hope you're not feeling too lonely.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Oh, I forgot. Robo-Nene's at home with you, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Emu, wait!
You're getting off track!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Ahem...
Today, Nene, we've put this video together in the hopes that it'll give you some encouragement!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<We hope you get to watch this.
Now, it's showtime!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. They made this for me?
It's a cute video. I like how so many of the plushies are in it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hiya, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, they even got Miku and the others to join in...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Nene, we're all really looking forward to seeing your show☆>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And please be sure to visit once it's over. We'd love to throw you all an after-party to celebrate a job well done.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We hope that you figure out the solution to your problem and are able to put on a wonderful performance!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Hehe. None of us can wait to hear you sing your beautiful songs as the Cowardly Canary, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <It pains us that we can't be of more help, but we're sure that you'll find a way...!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <We unfortunately won't be much assistance when it comes to singing. That being said, we're always willing to lend an ear to your worries.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Ready, everyone?! One, two...>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
<You can do it, Nene!>
<You can do it, Neneee!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about a sudden surprise...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, shouldn't they be practicing instead of making a video like this?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to figure this out...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So that I don't end up ruining our show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I should start with what I can do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But... What can I do...?
I could go back to basics and try to pinpoint my habits...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, Rui said that my habits may have nothing to do with my actual singing skills...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Would seeing other singers perform help?
Figuring out one person's habits or tendencies might lead to something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, I'll check that video site for...
A few hours later
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was hoping I could get in a quick nap, but it's already time for us to start practicing by ourselves...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, there are some things that I wanna try from those videos I saw. No one else seems to be practicing here, so now's my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I saved that list...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Those videos showed me that every singer has their own habits and tendencies.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I watched as many as I could and created a list of them all...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I can find someone with the same habits as me, that would really help...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll keep looking at this list while I sing and see if anything does match up.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have thirty in total. Some are subtle, some are fairly conspicuous. It's a lot, but I should test them all before practice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, let's begin...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Peculiar breath timing”...
Not sure that one applies to me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Voice jumps at the end of songs”... No, not really... “Exaggerates vibratos a lot”... Kind of? But I have a hard time believing that's the answer...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's twenty-five...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Am I going about this right...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I went through twenty-five of these and I still don't have a clue as to what my problem is...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The answer could be hiding within these last five, but if it's not...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'd have the restart from scratch...
What do I do then...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It feels like I'm not making any progress at all despite doing everything I possibly can.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also, in the back of my mind, I know our show's just around the corner. It's why I've been trying to quickly figure out a solution to all this.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I am going about this all wrong, I probably won't make it in time for...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, now's not the time for that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While I'm running circles in my head, the others are practicing and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Running further and further ahead...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to believe in myself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I have five left...
The answer has to be in here somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It has to be. I have to find it. Because...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I want to go on stage, sing and...!)
You'll lose your voice if you keep singing like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin...?!
